notes.title: Updates for including Sky Garden DLC
notes.notes: We're releasing a new DLC titled Sky Garden which you can purchase and download from Steam.

notes.title: Voice Over and Performance Update
notes.notes:
All the voice over for experiences have been updated.
Voice level is normalised to a more pleasant level.

The lake house experience has been updated to create a better frame rate performance.
We've removed variety of objects that may have caused jittering on the screen.

Hope you enjoy this update and make a better experience.

notes.title: InstacalmVR 2.0 - The White Room
notes.notes:
[b]Major update InstacalmVR 2.0[/b]

With this release we have reworked instacalmVR to host multiple experiences. 

In addition to the Lake house our guided relaxation escape to nature  

[previewyoutube=T0K9fmY4bBM;full][/previewyoutube]

We now have our 4 step relaxation training program. Learning the steps of mindfulness of the breathe and diaphragmatic breathing, we develop this experience to basic visualisations in our four modules.
